name: save_memory
description: Save a fact, user preference, or important piece of information to the shared persistent memory. The memory is visible to all agents and survives across sessions. Use it for long-term information (max 500 characters).

content.description: The fact or information to remember, in a concise form (max 500 characters).

summary.description: Optional short label (max 72 characters, like a commit subject) summarizing what this memory holds. Shown in memory listings instead of 'content'. When omitted, it is derived from the content automatically. Example: 'User preference: replies in Italian', not a generic phrase.

kind.description: Optional category guiding how long the memory is retained and how it is shared: 'facts' (default, general knowledge), 'run' (ephemeral run/turn notes, evicted first), 'decision' (project decisions, shared across agents and kept long), 'lesson' (lasting teachings, kept longest and shared across agents).

global.description: If true, stores the memory at global scope (visible in every workspace). If false or omitted, stores it in the current workspace scope.
